title: Arbitrary-ring etale and ringed-site derived projection maps agree
statement:
Let $\Lambda$ be any commutative ring and $u:X\to Y$ any morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Use small presentations of the small etale sites in a common coefficient universe [def-weil-size-convention, def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Write $\Lambda_T$ for the sheafification of the constant ring presheaf on $T_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf]. For $T=X,Y$, let $C_T:\operatorname{Mod}(\Lambda_T)\to\operatorname{Sh}(T_{\mathrm{et}},\operatorname{Mod}_\Lambda)$ be restriction of the action to constant scalar sections, with its canonical inverse extending the action to locally represented scalar sections [lem-sfb-constant-scalar-restriction-tensor]. Equip the ringed-topos morphism $u_{\mathrm{et}}$ with the constant-section-preserving ring isomorphism $c:u^{-1}\Lambda_Y\xrightarrow{\sim}\Lambda_X$ of [prop-weil-pbc-inverse-image-modules-exact]. Use ordinary unbounded derived categories [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories, def-weil-abstract-derived-category], the fixed-coefficient signed K-flat derived tensor [def-kun-derived-tensor], and the ringed-site K-flat tensor and pullback and K-injective direct image [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback, lem-weil-pbc-ringed-projection-mate-exact].

The induced equivalences $D(C_T)$ identify these specified derived tensor bifunctors, their signed-total representative comparisons, canonical associators, unitors and Koszul symmetries. Under these tensor identifications, they identify the termwise exact fixed-coefficient inverse image and its K-injective right-derived direct image with $Lu_{\mathrm{et}}^*$ and $Ru_{\mathrm{et}*}$ along $c$, including the canonical derived adjunction Hom bijections, units and counits. The canonical inverse pullback tensor comparison $\delta^u_{M,N}:u^{-1}(M\otimes^L N)\xrightarrow{\sim}u^{-1}M\otimes^L u^{-1}N$ (the inverse of [lem-kun-inverse-image-monoidal]) is carried to the specified ringed pullback comparison, computed on every flat-term K-flat pair by the ordinary pure-tensor comparison. Thus the corresponding small ringed-site corners, their ordinary K-flat representative models, and the edge induced by $u_{\mathrm{et}}$ realize the canonical tensor, adjunction and tensor-comparison data used by [lem-sfb-ringed-projection-tensor-associativity], with the tensor constraints normalized as in [def-sfb-ringed-projection-coherence-data].

In particular the projection morphism $\mathrm{PF}_u(E,L)$ of [def-kun-projection-formula-map] corresponds to that edge's specified ringed projection morphism: both are the adjunct, under the identified canonical adjunction, of
$$(\varepsilon_{u,E}\otimes1_{u^{-1}L})\circ\delta^u_{Ru_*E,L}:u^{-1}(Ru_*E\otimes^L L)\longrightarrow E\otimes^L u^{-1}L.$$
These are identifications of the specified natural transformations on all unbounded inputs. No finiteness of $\Lambda$, properness of $u$, boundedness, constructibility, Tor-amplitude, or invertibility of a projection morphism is assumed.
